entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... yes, hello. I... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought a couple of weeks ago. I'm just so disappointed with it.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're disappointed. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand the situation, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue?

It's not broken, I don't think. It's just so... hard to use. The data it shows is really confusing and I honestly expected more. I’ve read through the user manual a few times and it just isn't clicking. I've been a loyal customer for years and I saved up for this... I really needed this money back.

I completely understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. I see you received the sensor 16 days ago. For preference-based issues outside of the first 10 days, our policy is to first ensure you're getting the absolute most out of the features. Sometimes there are settings that aren't obvious. Could you tell me a bit more about what you were hoping to see on the screen during your ride?
Well, I want to know if my pedaling speed is good or not. It just gives me a number, like '92', but I have no idea what that means. I thought it would be more intuitive.

Ah, that is a perfect example of a feature that can be customized to be much more helpful. You're looking for Cadence Zones, and we can absolutely get that set up for you. Do you have your phone with the VeloFit app nearby?
Yes, I have it right here.

Great. Please open the VeloFit app, and on the main 'Ride' screen, tap on 'Customize Layout'. From there, you can add a new data field. Look for one called 'Cadence Zone Bar'. If you add that to your screen, it will show you a real-time, color-coded bar that moves as you pedal. It immediately tells you if you're in your target zone. Does that sound like what you were looking for?
Oh! I see it. 'Cadence Zone Bar'... wow. Okay, I just added it. So the colors tell me if I'm doing it right? That's... that's actually exactly what I wanted. I can't believe I missed that.

I'm so glad that helps! It's a powerful tool, and I'm happy we could get it working for you. And listen, I can see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your patience and for being such a great customer, I'd like to add a free 3-month VeloFit Premium subscription to your account. It includes guided workouts that use those very cadence zones to help you train.
Really? You'd do that? That's incredibly kind. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've completely turned this around for me. I'm actually excited to use it now.
It's my pleasure. The Premium subscription is now active on your account. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You are very welcome. Have a great ride!
